map.基于行业产排污系数估算固体废物产生量: Estimate solid waste generation from industry pollutant generation coefficients
map.📖 查看「固废产生系数估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Solid Waste Generation Coefficient Estimation Guide"
map.固废产生量 = 产品产量 × 产污系数；回收量 = 总量 × 回收比例；处置量: Solid waste generated = product output × pollutant generation coefficient; recycled = total × recovery share; disposed = total × disposal share; stockpiled = total − recycled − disposed (negative values set to zero)
map.产污系数取行业典型值（kg/单位）：煤炭采选 300、金属矿采选 1000、钢铁: The coefficient takes a typical industry value (kg/unit): coal mining and washing 300, metal ore mining and processing 1000, iron and steel smelting 400, thermal power 250, chemicals 150, building materials 50, paper 200, textiles 60, food processing 100; switch to "custom" to enter your own. Totals are in kg and shown in tonnes at 1000 kg or more; recovery and disposal split the flow by percentage and the remainder is stockpiled or discharged, for reference in industrial solid waste ledgers and compliance accounting.
map.数据来源：全国污染源普查工业固废产排污系数手册（参考值）: Data source: National Pollution Source Census manual of industrial solid waste generation and discharge coefficients (reference values)
map.📚 深度解析：固废产生系数估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Solid Waste Generation Coefficient Estimation
map.行业测算：录入产量与单位产废系数，求固废量。: Industry estimate: enter the output and unit waste coefficient to obtain the solid waste volume.
map.治理规划：对不同行业录入参数，汇总区域总量。: Management planning: enter parameters for different industries and aggregate the regional total.
map.教学演示：演示系数法在宏观估算的简便性。: Teaching demo: show how convenient the coefficient method is for macro estimates.
map.示例：产钢 100 万 t、吨钢产废系数 0.3 t，固废≈30 万 t（需按实: Example: 1 million t of steel output with a waste coefficient of 0.3 t per tonne gives ≈ 300000 t of solid waste (to be corrected by the actual composition).
map.行业平均水平，工艺先进者更低；精确需实测，规划级用系数足够。结果按公开标准与环境: They are industry averages, lower for advanced processes; accurate work needs measurement, but coefficients suffice for planning. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.一般固废与危废分列，危废须单独按名录管理，不可混算。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算: General solid waste and hazardous waste are listed separately; hazardous waste must be managed individually under the catalogue and cannot be lumped together. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.清洁生产、循环利用与工艺改进是源头减量主路径。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算，供科: Cleaner production, circular use and process improvement are the main paths to reduction at source. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.固废产生系数是一款科学研究领域的在线工具。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精: Solid Waste Generation Coefficient is an online tool in the scientific research field. A scientific research tool using standard scientific formulas for accurate calculation.
